Markets.title: BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, Nomura among key investors as Zetwerk mops up Rs 2,251 crore in anchor bidding; IPO opens on Oct 15
Markets.summary: Zetwerk raised Rs 2,251 crore from 99 anchor investors, including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and Nomura, ahead of its IPO. The Rs 5,012 crore public issue opens on October 15 and closes on October 19 at a price band of Rs 143 to Rs 151 per share.

Markets.title: US Fed’s Bowman sees no urgency for another rate hike
Markets.summary: US Federal Reserve Vice Chair Michelle Bowman stated there is no immediate need for more interest rate hikes following a recent increase to a 3.75%-4.00% target range. She also emphasized the necessity for stronger bank oversight due to recent financial failures.

Markets.title: Jio IPO sparks investor buzz: GMP hits 20% as Reliance’s telecom arm announces price band, dates
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms has announced a Rs 30,213 crore IPO opening from October 21 to October 23, poised to become India's largest-ever public issue. Ahead of the launch, the grey market premium has hit 20%, reaching Rs 220 over the upper price band of Rs 1,119.

Markets.title: Jio IPO: 5 strengths that put the Reliance-backed digital giant in spotlight
Markets.summary: Reliance Jio has highlighted five key strengths, including revenue growth, profitability, and proprietary technology, in its red herring prospectus for a Rs 30,213 crore IPO. The company also identified future growth opportunities in fixed broadband, AI-led services, digital subscriptions, and overseas technology monetization.

Markets.title: Sebi confirms interim curbs on Rajesh Exports, says financial disclosure concerns remain unresolved
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has confirmed interim restrictions on Rajesh Exports and its promoter, Rajesh Mehta. The action stems from unresolved concerns regarding financial disclosures, potential misrepresentation, and the routing of company funds through personal accounts.

Markets.title: IPO ahead! Paramotor Digital Technology files updated draft papers with Sebi for Rs 1,000 crore issue
Markets.summary: Fintech firm Paramotor Digital Technology has filed updated draft papers with Sebi for a Rs 1,000 crore initial public offering. The proposed issue includes a fresh issue worth Rs 698 crore and an offer for sale of Rs 302 crore.

Geo-Political.title: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine war linked to political situation, Zelensky aide says
Geo-Political.summary: A top aide to Ukrainian President Zelensky stated that restrictions on Elon Musk's Starlink satellite system during the war are tied to political developments. Starlink currently helps Ukraine defend its airspace and direct drones toward Russian military targets.

Geo-Political.title: Pope walking and recovering 'as expected' after surgery, doctors say
Geo-Political.summary: Doctors report that the 71-year-old Pope is walking and recovering as expected following a 90-minute surgery. During the procedure on Tuesday, he was diagnosed with lung cancer.

Geo-Political.title: US inflation rises more than expected - here's what is happening with prices
Geo-Political.summary: US inflation increased to 3.7% in the year leading up to September. This unexpected rise was primarily driven by higher costs for motor fuel.

Geo-Political.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
Geo-Political.summary: Four years after the attacks on Russia's Nord Stream gas pipelines to Germany, a Ukrainian man named Serhii Kuznetsov has gone on trial in Germany. He is accused of participating in the plot to destroy the infrastructure.

Geo-Political.title: Australia's first-ever Michelin stars go to 11 restaurants in one state
Geo-Political.summary: Eleven restaurants in South Australia received Australia's first-ever Michelin stars. This milestone occurred reportedly because the state government funded the visits of incognito inspectors.

Geo-Political.title: Netflix to shed 1,000 jobs in steepest cuts since 2022
Geo-Political.summary: Netflix is cutting 1,000 jobs, which equates to about 6% of its global workforce. This represents the streaming company's steepest layoffs since 2022.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top ten artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and maintain a competitive edge.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create digital media. The platform also enables creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: India Inc employee attrition rises to 18% in 2026; AI is changing how companies manage talent, shows new study
Data & Insights.summary: Employee attrition in India increased from 16.2% in 2025 to 18% in 2026 despite stable salary budgets. A new study shows that artificial intelligence is transforming how companies manage their talent amid this rise in turnover.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Board of directors is expanding’: Jaishankar pitches bigger role for ‘middle powers’ in changing global order
Data & Insights.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has called for an expanded global role for "middle powers" amid a changing international order. This follows a similar proposal earlier this year by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney for middle powers to unite as the U.S.-led rules-based order declines.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal on China ties: India is ready to rebuild economic relations, but there's a catch
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is open to restoring economic relations with China. However, he emphasized that any future engagement must guarantee fair terms, policy continuity, and geopolitical stability.

Data & Insights.title: Why IMF’s growth upgrade for India doesn’t tell the full story
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF raised India's 2026-27 GDP growth forecast to 7 percent based on strong domestic momentum. However, currency depreciation reduced its nominal dollar GDP, temporarily dropping India behind the UK to sixth in global rankings.

Data & Insights.title: Wholesale inflation rises to 11.39% in September on jump in fuel, food, manufactured products prices
Data & Insights.summary: Wholesale inflation increased to 11.39% in September, driven by higher prices for fuel, food, and manufactured products. Specifically, the food index rose to 8.66% in September from 7.05% in August.

Data & Insights.title: Fixing current account deficit key to stablizing rupee: BCG's Janmejaya Sinha
Data & Insights.summary: India's current account deficit is primarily driven by oil, gas, and gold imports, which have not been seriously addressed. Fixing this deficit is essential for stabilizing the rupee, according to BCG India Chairman Janmejaya Sinha.

India.title: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi Protest At India Gate With Parents Of Uttarakhand Murder Victim Ankita Bhandari
India.summary: Congress leaders Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi joined the parents of murdered Uttarakhand victim Ankita Bhandari in a protest at India Gate. The parents are protesting the appointment of BJP leader Dushyant Kumar Gautam as Sikkim governor, alleging he is the "VIP" linked to the 2022 case.

India.title: Baby Thrown From 1st Floor, Many Jump To Escape Delhi Restaurant Fire
India.summary: During a restaurant fire in Delhi, several people jumped from windows and roofs to escape the flames. A baby was also thrown from the first floor to safety.

India.title: Can't Make Lame Excuses: Top Court Pulls Up Poll Body Over Missing Footage
India.summary: The Supreme Court criticized the Election Commission for failing to provide video footage from the 2023 vote counting and a recent recount in Karnataka's Sringeri constituency. The court rejected the poll body's excuses and demanded accountability regarding the missing election records.

India.title: Accused Of Sex Abuse During Protest, Delhi Cop Files Case Against Journalist Under SC/ST Act
India.summary: Delhi Police Assistant Commissioner Vivek Bhagat filed a case against a journalist under the SC/ST Act, claiming the reporter made derogatory caste remarks in public. The complaint follows allegations that Bhagat committed sexual abuse during a protest.

India.title: Mobile Phones, Drugs Smuggled Into Punjab Jails. 22 Named In Police Cases
India.summary: Police filed cases against 22 individuals regarding mobile phones and drugs smuggled into Punjab jails. Investigators suspect prison staff accepted bribes from inmates and their families to facilitate the contraband.

India.title: Video: Bikes Skid As Painted Kolkata Flyover After Beautification Drive Turns It Slippery
India.summary: Multiple motorcyclists slipped and fell on the newly painted Chingrighata flyover in Kolkata during rain. The beautification drive caused the road surface to become dangerously slippery.

General.title: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', prosecution alleges as rape trial begins
General.summary: Actor and comedian Russell Brand is on trial after being accused of acting as a "sexual predator." He has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one count of indecent assault.

General.title: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine war linked to political situation, Zelensky aide says
General.summary: A Ukrainian presidential aide stated that Elon Musk's restrictions on Starlink satellite services in Ukraine are linked to the ongoing political situation. The Starlink system is used by Kyiv to protect Ukrainian airspace and guide drones against Russian targets.

General.title: Burnham treads carefully in Zelensky visit, balancing Trump and Ukraine
General.summary: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky following a difficult week for the Ukrainian leader. The visit involved delicate diplomatic balancing between maintaining support for Ukraine and managing relations with Donald Trump.

General.summary: The Irish writer is best known for novels such as Normal People, Intermezzo and Conversations With Friends.

General.summary: William Chapman was attacked by the tiger after he entered its pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park.
